body:
During school, I usually try to stay away from drugs of any nature, but Friday night I had an overwhelming urge to take E.  I got my friend J to help me find it.  Since it was after midnight that we decided to do this, we exhausted all of our resources except the club scene.  We bought our pills about 5 minutes after getting to the club.  They were double stacked white unicorns.  We left and went back to our friend's apartment.
The apartment was nice because it was amply air conditioned and there was easy access to water.  We ate our pills (2.5 pills each) around 3:30 AM.  About 4, I was sick to my stomach.
Soon after I was rolling harder than I had ever rolled before (I've been known to eat 7 pills on several occassions).  I really enjoyed that portion of the experience.  After a certain point, I can only remember bits and pieces and I was told I wandered around talking to myself alot.
I do remember having mild hallucinations.  I enjoyed this aspect as well, but I usually do not enjoy prolonged hallicinations.  Please note that we did not know the pills contained AMT until the following afternoon.
J and I realized we were still rolling ('blowing up' and euphoric) by about 10AM.  By noon I felt like I was still rolling and was not happy as I did not feel tired and I felt like my hands and feet were asleep.  I felt extremely weak.  J's pupil's (any probably mine) were huge.  I asked to be taken to a friend's house because I wasn't confident I was able to drive. Upon getting to my friend's house I got out of the car, and immediately blacked out.  I blacked out 3 or 4 times more in the next 10 or so minutes.  I could not stand up without blacking out.
I got in bed and could not sleep.  I got sick several times and I continued having mild hallucinations until around 6 or 7 PM.  I was unable to eat anything until mid-Sunday (the tightness of jaw went away around the same time)
Overall the actual experience was nice, but the after effects lasted two days too long and were not pleasant at all.  J had a similar side effect experience but without blacking out.
Long story short...the side effects are more prevelant if the user is not well rested.  Side effects went away with sleep.
